claims.statement: The Met dates the emergence of Arnhem Land’s X-ray rock-art style to around 2000 BCE and describes it as continuing to the present.
Artists depicted internal organs and bones within human and animal figures.

evidence.locator: Timeline; Overview; Key Events for Arnhem Land and Lapita
evidence.note: The timeline is clipped at 200 CE to fit this collection’s study window; this is not the end of a continuing Aboriginal artistic tradition. Dates are approximate and do not date every painting. No single map point is assigned.
